items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: Who else was in the band when Oliver was there at Abedee's? ... Miney Jones.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band when Oliver was there at Abedee's? Who else? Do you remember? Was it Richard M Jones?
Oh yeah. Miney, Miney's name was, we used to call him Miney. Miney Jones. Joseph Jones.
Why did they call him Miney? I never knew.
